# muck-engine

**Tag**: library

## 简介

The base engine for the muck system.  Contains common tables, custom for, css and javascript.

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/tatemae/muck-engine
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/muck-engine
